infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Hopday uses your location to check you in at the places on your plan and to show how long it takes to get to the next stop.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hopday uses the camera so you can photograph a ticket or booking and add it to your trip.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hopday opens your photos so you can add screenshots of bookings and tickets to your trip.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hopday uses the microphone when you ask the trip assistant something by voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Hopday turns what you say into text when you ask the trip assistant by voice.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Hopday reads your step count to show how far you walked on each day of your trip.
